description: Explain one rule from archprint_scan in depth, by its label (e.g. AP-002, env-access, or "lib !-> app"): its statement, gate status, adoption (enforce, review, or report-only, as in archprint_scan), observed conformance and confidence floor, and every file that breaks it (scan lists only a few). For the forbidden-import rules (AP-001, AP-002) it also returns each confidence-gate condition with its value and threshold, how to fix a violation, and when not to adopt the rule. Read-only.

id.description: rule label from archprint_scan, e.g. AP-002 or env-access

path.description: app or monorepo-root directory on this machine (default "."), not a URL

name: archprint_explain
title: Explain an architecture rule
